newsitem.title: USA: Circuit Systems acquires circuit board operation.
newsitem.headline: Circuit Systems acquires circuit board operation.

text.p: Circuit Systems Inc said Friday it closed the purchase of the printed circuit board manufacturing operations of Philips Consumer Electronics Co.
Financial terms were not disclosed. Philips Consumer Electronics is a unit of Philips Electronics NV.

"This acquisition will add approximately $20 million-$25 million to Circuit Systems' annual sales and help us achieve our goal of $100 million in sales in fiscal 1999," D.S. Patel, chief exectuive officer of Circuit Systems, said in a news release.
Circuit Systems shares rose 1/16 to 5-1/8 Friday.
